name: NGC 1872 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1872, a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1872-hubble
story: A rich cluster of thousands of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud. It is as crowded as a globular cluster yet much younger, so it sits between the usual classes of star clusters.

claims.text: NGC 1872 is a rich cluster of thousands of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud
NGC 1872 is about as rich as a typical globular cluster but much younger, an intermediate type between open and globular
